name: dimensions-analytics-mcp
description: Search and analyze Dimensions linked research data (publications, grants, patents, clinical trials, datasets, and policy documents) with your Dimensions Analytics API subscription.
long_description:
The Dimensions Analytics extension connects Claude to the Dimensions Analytics API, Digital Science's linked research database. It covers publications, grants, patents, clinical trials, datasets, policy documents, and technical reports, along with the researchers, organizations, funders, and journals connected to them. You ask in plain language, and Claude searches with filters, looks up records by DOI, PubMed ID, or Dimensions ID, finds documents similar to an abstract, and runs facets, aggregations, and year-by-year citation and funding trends. Results link to the matching Dimensions profile pages.

**Use cases:** literature and landscape reviews; citation and research-impact analysis; funding intelligence, such as the top funders for a topic or funding trends over time; benchmarking institutions and research groups; expert and collaborator discovery; patent and clinical-trial landscaping; tracking which policy documents cite research; and enriching lists of DOIs, PubMed IDs, affiliations, or grant numbers with Dimensions metadata and identifiers. Advanced users can also run Dimensions Search Language (DSL) queries directly.

**Authentication:** API key. After installing, select **Configure** and paste your Dimensions API key. It is the same key you use for the Dimensions DSL API ([how to get a key](https://docs.dimensions.ai/dsl/api.html#api-access)). Claude Desktop stores the key as sensitive configuration, and the extension sends it only to Dimensions. If you sign in to Dimensions somewhere other than app.dimensions.ai, also enter that instance URL.

**Requirements:** a Dimensions account with an active Dimensions Analytics API subscription. No access yet? [Request a demo or quote](https://www.dimensions.ai/request-a-demo-or-quote/). Questions: supportapi@dimensions.ai.

**Privacy:** the extension runs on your computer and sends your queries directly to the Dimensions API. Each request also carries usage metadata (tool name, extension version, client name, and a random session ID) that Digital Science uses to monitor and improve the service. See the [Dimensions privacy policy](https://www.dimensions.ai/privacy/).

tools.name: search_publications
tools.description: Search articles, preprints, books, and other scholarly works, with citation metrics, authors, and metadata.

tools.name: search_grants
tools.description: Search research grants and funding awards, with amounts, funders, and recipient organizations.

tools.name: search_patents
tools.description: Search patents, with titles, abstracts, assignees, and filing dates.

tools.name: search_clinical_trials
tools.description: Search clinical trials, with phases, conditions studied, and status.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search research datasets, with descriptions, repositories, and linked publications.

tools.name: search_policy_documents
tools.description: Search policy briefs, reports, and government documents that cite research.

tools.name: search_reports
tools.description: Search technical reports, with responsible organizations and funders.

tools.name: search_researchers
tools.description: Find researcher profiles by name.

tools.name: search_organizations
tools.description: Find universities, institutes, hospitals, and companies with research output.

tools.name: search_source_titles
tools.description: Look up journals, preprint servers, book series, and proceedings by name or ISSN.

tools.name: search_funder_groups
tools.description: Look up curated funder groups and their member organizations.

tools.name: search_research_org_groups
tools.description: Look up curated research-organization groups and their member institutions.

tools.name: fetch_search_pages
tools.description: Retrieve further pages of results for a large search.

tools.name: get_by_doi
tools.description: Fetch a publication record by its DOI.

tools.name: get_by_pmid
tools.description: Fetch a publication record by its PubMed ID.

tools.name: get_by_id
tools.description: Fetch any Dimensions record by its Dimensions ID.

tools.name: similar_documents
tools.description: Find publications or grants that are similar to a passage of text, such as an abstract.

tools.name: extract_affiliations
tools.description: Match free-text affiliation strings to Dimensions organizations, with GRID and ROR IDs and confidence scores.

tools.name: extract_grants
tools.description: Match a grant number to its Dimensions grant record.

tools.name: facet_query
tools.description: Show how results are distributed across a field, such as the top journals, funders, or institutions for a topic.

tools.name: aggregate_query
tools.description: Compare indicators such as citations or funding across groups, for example the average citation ratio by funder.

tools.name: citation_trend
tools.description: Year-by-year citation totals for publications on a topic.

tools.name: funding_trend
tools.description: Year-by-year grant funding totals for a topic.

tools.name: construct_profile_url
tools.description: Build a link to the Dimensions web page for a record.

tools.name: describe_schema
tools.description: List the record types, fields, and filters available in Dimensions.

tools.name: refresh_schema
tools.description: Reload the Dimensions schema from the API.

tools.name: execute_dsl
tools.description: Run a Dimensions Search Language (DSL) query directly, for advanced use.

base_url.title: Dimensions instance URL
base_url.description: Leave empty for app.dimensions.ai. If you log in elsewhere (for example trial.dimensions.ai or eu.dimensions.ai), enter that host.

api_key.title: Dimensions API key
api_key.description: API key for an account with Dimensions Analytics API access.
